caption: The drawing features a single marionette puppet figure positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The puppet is depicted standing upright with visible black strings attached to its head, hands, and legs, extending upward out of the frame. The marionette has dark, wooden articulated limbs and a head with carved facial features, including large round eyes, a broad nose, and a wide mouth. The puppet is outfitted with a textured, green, short-sleeved sweater and what appears to be white or uncolored shorts or undergarments. The hands and feet are large and blocky, consistent with the puppet's stylized, mechanical appearance. The overall composition is vertically oriented and the only color present besides shades of black, gray, and white is the green of the sweater. The background remains unadorned and untextured. A small signature reading "Joseph Kellner" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Cannibal Marionette
